name: Inder Kaur Resilience Scholarship (RMIT)
summary: Up to $8,000 a year for women at RMIT with a past or current experience of family violence.
key: Up to $8,000 a year full-time for up to five years, or $4,000 part-time for up to ten. One offered.
who: Identifies as a woman with a past or current experience of family violence.
Australian citizen, permanent resident or permanent humanitarian visa holder.
how: Complete the online application with supporting documents.

evidence.quote: Up to $8,000 per annum for full-time enrolled students, for up to five years
